core_struggle: After months, has just signed their first paying customer and resolves to stay grounded through the year ahead instead of riding highs and lows.
mirror: The first customer signed yesterday, and the part that matters begins now.

queries.hook: A first win after fourteen months, and the resolve to stay steady through the year ahead instead of riding the wave.
queries.diagnose: Resolve fades when the mind runs ahead to the prize; it holds when the work itself is the reward.
queries.steady: Your own path walked imperfectly is enough; no honest effort is ever lost, and effort is yours while results are not.
queries.act: Rise and act; do your work fully and let the result go, one day at a time.
queries.story: A builder who had just won their first commission, faced the long months of keeping it going, and kept their resolve through it.

bridge: What you are living with is what the texts call starting what is yours to build, and that is where this week begins.
week_thesis: The first customer is the start of the part that matters. Over seven days the high becomes fuel and the low becomes practice.

week_beats.hook: You recognise the resolve and the win, and the danger of letting the high carry you.
week_beats.diagnose: You see that the mind will want to ride the high, and that is what will test the resolve.
week_beats.steady: You hold that effort is yours and results are not.
week_beats.story: A builder who won their first commission and then had to keep it going shows you how to hold steady.

insight: You have the resolve to stay grounded, and the thing that will test it is the very win you just had. The high is real, and the low will come.
seat: a builder who has just secured their first paying customer
life_context: In their mid-thirties and building something of their own; after fourteen months the first paying customer signed yesterday, and they know the harder part begins now.
